task_instruction: Implement the fleet radar target acquisition setup from the tutorial. In `res://data/units/unit_stats.gd`, define `TARGET = { Team.PLAYER: "fleet_b", Team.ENEMY: "fleet_a" }` so units can look up the opposing group name from their team. Create `res://custom_nodes/detect_range.gd` as `class_name DetectRange` extending `Area2D` with exported `col_shape: CollisionShape2D`, `base_range_size: float`, and `stats: UnitStats`; when `stats` is assigned, set `collision_layer` to `4 * (stats.team + 1)`, set `collision_mask` to `2 - stats.team`, and replace the collision shape with a `CircleShape2D` whose radius is `base_range_size * stats.attack_range`. Create `res://custom_nodes/target_finder.gd` as `class_name TargetFinder` extending `Node` with an exported `actor: BattleUnit`, a `target: BattleUnit`, a `targets_in_range: Array[BattleUnit]`, and a `targets_in_range_changed` signal. On ready, connect the actor's `DetectRange.area_entered` and `area_exited` signals to handlers that append or erase only `BattleUnit` instances and emit `targets_in_range_changed`. Implement `find_target()` so it uses `UnitStats.TARGET`, `get_nodes_in_group()`, and `distance_squared_to()` to store the closest opposing `BattleUnit` in `target`, and implement `has_target_in_range()` to return whether `targets_in_range` is non-empty. In `res://scenes/battle_unit/battle_unit.tscn`, add a `DetectRange` Area2D child with a `CollisionShape2D` child and a sibling `TargetFinder` node, wire both to the battle unit, and in `res://scenes/battle_unit/battle_unit.gd` expose them as `detect_range` and `target_finder` onready variables while assigning `detect_range.stats = stats` when battle-unit stats are set.
